description: §19.16.6 — lowering a `defer` does not change the meaning of the rest of the block: a nested `function` declared AFTER the `defer` is still visible to code BEFORE it (block hoisting). f() calls helper() before any defer; helper is declared after two defers. trace = "H;body;D2;D1;" (no TypeError).
rationale: §19.16.6: a nested function declaration written after the `defer` stays visible to the whole block, as it is without the `defer`; deferred bodies then run LIFO at exit (§19.16.2).
